item.title: GPU
item.description:
go-wasmcontainers/gpu is the module for GPU access from WASI containers: wasi-nn inference, wasi:webgpu compute and rendering, on WebGPU in the browser and on the CPU natively. Pure Go. The design and its references are in docs/DESIGN.md.

Status (v0.1.0): only the ONNX loader and its CPU operators exist. Everything that uses a GPU is planned.

Part State
onnx: ONNX model loader and CPU operators done (v0.1.0)
wasi-nn host module (wasi_ephemeral_nn) and guest bindings next
wasi:webgpu compute (browser) planned
rendering to a dashboard pane planned

onnx

It loads an ONNX model with a bounded protobuf reader and runs it on the CPU. Operators: Add, AveragePool, Concat, Constant, Conv, Div, Dropout (inference), Flatten, Gemm, Identity, MatMul, MaxPool, Mul, Relu, Reshape, Softmax, Sub and Transpose (default domain, operator sets 7 and later, float tensors, int64 for shapes).

  • It refuses precisely: a model using anything else fails at load, naming every unsupported operator and its node count.
  • It is checked op by op against the ONNX node tests (onnx v1.22.0): the 122 tests whose models load here pass with the ONNX backend’s tolerances, and MNIST-12 from the ONNX model zoo passes on its own test data.
  • The model is untrusted input: sizes, node count, rank, elements and the multiply-accumulates of one inference are bounded, and the decoder and runner are fuzzed.

Performance has not been measured yet.
